ops.text: ccx vcs ship on a fresh branch cut from origin/main in yasyf/cc-remote printed 'moved the native stack ... onto main' and 'onto main (was yasyf/worker-trunk-key)', yet opened PR #92 with base yasyf/deb-no-download-archives, a branch that landed as #87, so the PR showed 16 files instead of 2. Retargeted by hand with gh pr edit --base main. ccx read stale native-stack metadata for an untracked new branch and submitted against it despite its own plan line.
